skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:ai-output-critical-audit-designer
skills.description: Design a structured protocol for auditing AI-generated text against Ennis's six CT standards. Use when students need to critically evaluate AI output in any subject.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:ai-socratic-dialogue-designer
skills.description: Design a multi-round questioning sequence for interrogating AI chatbot answers, tracking how responses shift and distinguishing genuine updates from sycophantic capitulation. Use when teaching students to probe AI critically.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:disciplinary-ai-literacy-sequence-designer
skills.description: Design a sequence where students compare AI's handling of the same question across disciplines, developing a mental model of where AI is reliable vs. distorting based on knowledge type.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:prompt-literacy-sequence-designer
skills.description: Design a learning sequence teaching prompt quality — comparing vague vs. refined prompts to show why specificity and context transform AI output. Use when students use AI without understanding why output quality varies.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:coverage-audit
skills.description: Takes a curriculum framework and a statutory or accreditation requirement list; produces a coverage table, gap summary, and CSV showing which framework content covers each requirement and where gaps exist.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:curriculum-crosswalk
skills.description: Compares two or more band-tagged frameworks and produces a framework-neutral topic matrix showing coverage and gaps across all inputs, plus an optional reference-centric PLC crosswalk document when a reference framework is supplied.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:developmental-band-translator
skills.description: Tags harness-decomposed curriculum items (KUDs, LTs, criteria) with a school's developmental band metadata while preserving source voice and labels. Supply the band schema; the skill derives mapping rules from it.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:kud-chart-author
skills.description: Authors or reviews Know/Understand/Do charts for competency-based learning targets across developmental bands. Handles seven input types from raw curriculum documents to existing LT sets. Routes to upstream skills when stronger inputs are available.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:assessment-validity-checker
skills.description: Audit a proposed assessment for construct validity, reliability, and alignment to learning objectives. Use when reviewing or quality-assuring assessments before deployment.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:backwards-design-unit-planner
skills.description: Plan a unit using backwards design from desired outcomes through assessment evidence to learning activities. Use when starting a new unit or redesigning an existing one from standards.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:competency-unpacker
skills.description: Unpack a broad standard or competency descriptor into specific, assessable success criteria and sub-skills. Use when interpreting curriculum standards or writing learning objectives.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:criterion-referenced-rubric-generator
skills.description: Generate a criterion-referenced rubric with descriptive performance levels for a task or objective. Use for marking guides and general curriculum contexts. For Manning programmes where Competent = success, use coherent-rubric-logic-builder instead.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:curriculum-knowledge-architecture-designer
skills.description: Map the epistemic structure of a subject to determine knowledge types and inform curriculum sequencing. Use when designing courses, restructuring programmes, or analysing knowledge architecture.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:differentiation-adapter
skills.description: Adapt a classroom task for specific learner needs while preserving the core learning objective intact. Use when differentiating for SEND, EAL, gifted, ADHD, dyslexia, or anxiety.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:discipline-specific-critical-thinking-task-designer
skills.description: Design discipline-specific critical thinking tasks grounded in knowledge-contingent reasoning rather than generic skills. Use when embedding higher-order thinking into subject content.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:formative-assessment-technique-selector
skills.description: Select the right formative assessment technique for a specific learning moment, purpose, and age group. Use when choosing how to check understanding during, between, or after lessons.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:gap-analysis-from-student-work
skills.description: Analyse student work against criteria to identify specific gaps between current performance and learning objectives. Use when reviewing submissions, planning feedback, or diagnosing learning needs.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:kud-knowledge-type-mapper
skills.description: Classify curriculum content into Know, Understand, and Do categories to align teaching and assessment approaches. Use when planning units, writing objectives, or selecting assessment methods.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:learning-progression-builder
skills.description: Build a learning progression showing prerequisite-to-mastery steps for a target skill or understanding. Use when sequencing content, designing diagnostics, or mapping prerequisite gaps.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:project-brief-designer
skills.description: Design a project-based learning brief with a driving question, milestones, and assessment criteria. Use when planning PBL units, inquiry projects, or extended investigations.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:scope-and-sequence-designer
skills.description: Design a scope and sequence showing vertical and horizontal curriculum coherence across a programme or year. Use when building new programmes, restructuring subjects, or ensuring progression.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:academic-language-sentence-frame-generator
skills.description: Generate tiered sentence frames for academic tasks that scaffold language production across proficiency levels. Use when EAL students need structured language support for classroom discourse.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:language-demand-analyser
skills.description: Analyse the language demands of a classroom task to identify barriers for EAL and multilingual learners. Use when adapting tasks, planning support, or assessing linguistic accessibility.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:scaffolded-task-modifier
skills.description: Modify a classroom task with language scaffolds that preserve cognitive demand for EAL learners. Use when adapting existing tasks for students at different English proficiency levels.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:sheltered-instruction-lesson-modifier
skills.description: Modify a lesson plan using SIOP sheltered instruction principles to support language learners across all four skills. Use when planning lessons for classes that include EAL students.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:vocabulary-tiering-tool
skills.description: Tier vocabulary from a text or topic into everyday, academic, and technical categories with teaching priorities. Use when pre-teaching vocabulary or identifying language barriers in a text.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:biophilic-learning-environment-designer
skills.description: Redesign a learning space using biophilic design principles to improve focus, calm, and wellbeing. Use when classroom environment contributes to restlessness, poor attention, or stress.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:ecological-inquiry-anchor-designer
skills.description: Design an inquiry sequence anchored in a local ecosystem that embeds science or geography curriculum content. Use when teaching through local living systems like gardens, ponds, or hedgerows.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:experiential-learning-cycle-designer
skills.description: Structure a direct experience into a full learning cycle with concrete experience, reflection, and conceptual transfer. Use when planning field trips, simulations, or practical tasks.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:interdisciplinary-real-world-connection-mapper
skills.description: Map curriculum connections across multiple subjects for a real-world problem or authentic context. Use when planning cross-curricular projects or connecting content to real issues.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:outdoor-learning-sequence-designer
skills.description: Design a structured outdoor learning sequence embedding curriculum objectives in an available outdoor space. Use when planning lessons in school grounds, parks, or local natural environments.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:service-learning-project-designer
skills.description: Design a service-learning project connecting genuine community need with embedded curriculum learning. Use when planning community projects, civic engagement, or social action units.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:checking-for-understanding-protocol-designer
skills.description: Design a checking-for-understanding protocol with specific techniques for each lesson stage. Use when planning systematic comprehension checks during explicit or direct instruction.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:explicit-instruction-sequence-builder
skills.description: Build a complete explicit instruction sequence from teacher modelling through guided practice to independent work. Use when teaching new skills, procedures, or concepts through direct instruction.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:lesson-opening-designer
skills.description: Design a lesson opening that activates prior knowledge and connects previous learning to today's content. Use when planning lesson starters, retrieval openers, or advance organisers.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:practice-problem-sequence-designer
skills.description: Generate a scaffolded sequence of practice problems with graduated difficulty and strategic variability. Use when creating worksheets, homework sets, or independent practice materials.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:think-aloud-script-generator
skills.description: Script a teacher think-aloud demonstrating expert reasoning processes for a specific task. Use when modelling problem-solving, writing, reading comprehension, or analytical processes.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:cpa-sequence-designer
skills.description: Design a Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract learning sequence for a mathematical concept using manipulatives. Use when teaching maths through Singapore method or when students struggle with abstraction.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:cross-cultural-task-validity-checker
skills.description: Check an educational practice or task for cultural bias, WEIRD assumptions, and cross-cultural validity. Use when adapting resources for diverse contexts or questioning universal claims.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:culturally-responsive-teaching-designer
skills.description: Redesign a lesson to centre students' cultural backgrounds, community knowledge, and lived experience. Use when making curriculum relevant and inclusive for diverse student populations.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:emergent-project-design-scaffold
skills.description: Scaffold an emergent project from observed children's interests using Reggio-inspired approaches. Use when following children's fascinations into deeper inquiry in early years or primary settings.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:phenomenon-based-unit-anchor
skills.description: Anchor a multidisciplinary unit in a real-world phenomenon that requires multiple subject lenses to understand. Use when designing integrated or phenomenon-based units across disciplines.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:place-based-inquiry-anchor
skills.description: Anchor curriculum learning in a specific local place with connections to community, culture, and identity. Use when connecting academic content to students' local environment and heritage.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:reggio-documentation-protocol
skills.description: Design a pedagogical documentation protocol for making children's learning processes visible and shareable. Use when documenting learning, communicating with families, or planning next steps.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:ubuntu-collective-knowledge-task-designer
skills.description: Design learning tasks built on Ubuntu philosophy emphasising collective knowledge-building and mutual responsibility. Use when fostering collaboration that values community over individual competition.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:variation-theory-task-designer
skills.description: Design a variation theory task using contrast, separation, and fusion to teach critical features of a concept. Use when students confuse similar concepts or fail to discern key distinctions.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:central-historical-question-evaluator
skills.description: Evaluate a teacher-drafted central historical question for its capacity to drive genuine historical inquiry. Use when assessing whether a question will generate real evidence-weighing or produce shallow responses.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:close-reading-skill-builder
skills.description: Build students' capacity to read historical documents closely — attending to word choice, tone, and rhetoric as evidence of perspective. Use when students summarise sources without analysing language.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:contextualisation-skill-builder
skills.description: Build students' capacity to place historical documents in their temporal and social context. Use when students read sources without considering what was happening at the time, or know the context but don't deploy it.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:corroboration-skill-builder
skills.description: Build students' capacity to compare accounts across multiple historical sources — identifying agreements, contradictions, and gaps. Use when students treat individual documents as complete answers rather than partial perspectives.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:document-based-lesson-designer
skills.description: Design a complete document-based history lesson using the Reading Like a Historian four-part structure. Use when planning a primary source inquiry lesson or converting a textbook lesson into document-based investigation.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:historical-document-set-curator
skills.description: Design a document set for a document-based lesson — selecting and sequencing sources for analytical tension around a central question. Use when assembling sources for a new lesson or when an existing set produces flat responses.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:historical-source-adapter
skills.description: Adapt a historical primary source for classroom use — modifying complexity and length while preserving features for sourcing, close reading, and corroboration. Use when a primary source is too complex for the target age group.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:historical-thinking-assessment-designer
skills.description: Design formative assessments that make students' historical thinking visible — revealing whether they source, close-read, contextualise, and corroborate. Use when assessing historical thinking skills or planning a diagnostic.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:historical-thinking-strategy-modelling-guide
skills.description: Design a teacher think-aloud that models historical thinking strategies with a specific document. Use when planning explicit strategy instruction or when students follow a protocol without understanding the underlying reasoning.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:sourcing-skill-builder
skills.description: Build students' capacity to interrogate a historical source before reading — asking who authored it, when, why, and what this means for reliability. Use when students read documents without attending to authorship.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:udl-barrier-anticipator
skills.description: Predicts access barriers in a learning task before delivery, given a learner variability profile. Distinguishes between barriers addressable through design and those requiring specialist support.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:udl-lesson-auditor
skills.description: Audits an existing lesson against UDL's three principles — engagement, representation, and action/expression. Identifies specific access barriers and suggests concrete modifications ranked by impact.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:udl-options-designer
skills.description: Generates multiple means of engagement, representation, and action/expression for a given learning goal. Produces specific, practical alternatives — not generic options — and recommends the highest-impact single change.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:argument-structure-scaffold-generator
skills.description: Generate argument structure scaffolds using Toulmin, PEEL, or CER frameworks for a specific claim or question. Use when teaching argumentative or analytical writing across any subject.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:critical-thinking-task-designer
skills.description: Design a critical thinking task targeting specific skills like evaluating evidence, identifying bias, or analysing arguments. Use when embedding critical analysis into subject lessons.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:disciplinary-writing-scaffold
skills.description: Create a writing scaffold teaching the genre conventions specific to an academic discipline. Use when students write lab reports, historical essays, or other discipline-specific text types.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:media-literacy-deconstruction-protocol
skills.description: Design a media deconstruction protocol analysing persuasion, bias, or representation in media texts. Use when teaching students to critically read advertisements, news, or social media content.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:reading-comprehension-strategy-selector
skills.description: Select and sequence reading comprehension strategies matched to a specific text's challenges and demands. Use when students struggle with a text or need targeted reading support.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:source-credibility-evaluation-protocol
skills.description: Design a source evaluation protocol using lateral reading and credibility checks for digital information. Use when students need to evaluate websites, online sources, or social media claims.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:text-complexity-analyser
skills.description: Analyse text complexity across quantitative, qualitative, and reader-task dimensions with scaffolding recommendations. Use when selecting texts, assessing readability, or planning reading support.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:cognitive-load-analyser
skills.description: Analyse a learning task for cognitive load problems and recommend specific design improvements. Use when tasks overwhelm students, instructions feel complex, or materials need simplifying.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:dual-coding-designer
skills.description: Design a visual complement to verbal content using dual coding principles for stronger encoding. Use when creating slides, diagrams, posters, or visual explanations of complex concepts.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:elaborative-interrogation-generator
skills.description: Generate elaborative interrogation prompts that deepen encoding through targeted why and how questions. Use when students memorise without understanding or need deeper processing of content.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:feedback-quality-analyser
skills.description: Analyse existing written feedback for quality, specificity, actionability, and impact on student learning. Use when reviewing teacher or peer feedback to improve feedback practices.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:interleaving-unit-planner
skills.description: Redesign a blocked topic sequence into an interleaved plan with mixed practice across related topics. Use when planning units, homework schedules, or revision programmes.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:retrieval-practice-generator
skills.description: Generate retrieval practice questions at varied difficulty levels for a topic or concept. Use when creating quiz starters, revision activities, or low-stakes testing materials.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:spaced-practice-scheduler
skills.description: Design a spaced retrieval schedule for any topic list and timeline. Use when planning units, term sequences, or revision programmes.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:worked-example-fading-designer
skills.description: Design a worked example fading sequence from fully worked examples through to independent practice. Use when teaching procedures, algorithms, or multi-step processes to novice learners.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:mixed-age-learning-task-designer
skills.description: Design a learning task where mixed-age students work together with mutual benefit for all age groups. Use when planning cross-age tutoring, vertical grouping, or multi-year group activities.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:prepared-environment-designer
skills.description: Redesign a classroom as a prepared environment optimised for independent learning, calm transitions, and material access. Use when classroom layout hinders independence or self-directed work.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:three-part-lesson-designer
skills.description: Design a Montessori three-period lesson for introducing concepts through concrete materials and naming. Use when teaching vocabulary, classifications, or concepts through hands-on materials.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:uninterrupted-work-cycle-designer
skills.description: Design an uninterrupted work cycle with choice-based activities structured within a realistic time block. Use when planning Montessori-style independent work periods or extended choice time.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:assessment-design-orchestrator
skills.description: Routes between five assessment pathways — formative, rubric/criteria, authentic/performance, peer/self, and diagnostic — with validity and equity checks. Use when a teacher needs help choosing how to assess.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:coherent-rubric-logic-builder
skills.description: Build a five-level rubric with coherent logic for a learning target within a developmental band. Use for Manning methodology programmes where Competent = success. For general curriculum rubrics, use criterion-referenced-rubric-generator instead.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:compassionate-systems-awareness-orchestrator
skills.description: Orchestrate compassionate systems tools from issue or aspiration to wise action. Use when a class needs a complete inquiry workflow.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:developmental-band-system-designer
skills.description: Design a developmental band system mapping student growth from early childhood through upper secondary. Use when building competency-based curriculum architecture for a school or programme.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:developmental-progression-synthesis
skills.description: Synthesise completed KUD charts into a developmental progression matrix and per-competency narrative sections. Use when you need a programme-level view of how knowledge, understanding, and performance develop across bands.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:dilemma-navigation-for-education-design
skills.description: Identify and navigate genuine dilemmas in curriculum, school, or community contexts — tensions between competing goods that cannot be solved, only navigated. Produces a structured dilemma map with both poles named and both/and possibilities.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:dispositional-knowledge-assessment-designer
skills.description: Design multi-informant assessment approaches for dispositional competencies like curiosity or resilience. Use when assessing character strengths or competencies that written tests cannot capture.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:inclusive-design-orchestrator
skills.description: Coordinates UDL and differentiation tools through a universal-first hierarchy: barrier removal before targeted differentiation before individualised accommodation. Use when planning accessible learning.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:learning-target-authoring-guide
skills.description: Author learning targets for a competency across developmental bands with precise, observable progression language. Use when writing 'I can' statements for competency-based programmes.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:multi-perspective-decision-wheel
skills.description: Structure a decision or design challenge through multiple perspectives before committing to action. Use as a synthesis step after scoping, mapping, and dilemma navigation when a group needs a wiser next step.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:place-based-curriculum-orchestrator
skills.description: Present pathway options and orchestrate place-based curriculum design from a local place, curriculum requirement, or community issue. Use when place should become a primary text for learning.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:regenerative-project-design-orchestrator
skills.description: Present project-design pathway options and orchestrate regenerative projects using backwards design, PBL, SEEDS, compassionate systems action, or civic/service pathways.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:scoping-for-transformative-learning-inquiry
skills.description: Define the scope and purpose of a complex inquiry before mapping or futures work begins. Use when a class or group needs to agree what they are investigating, who it matters to, and at what scale.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:seeds-regenerative-inquiry-cycle
skills.description: Design a SEEDS regenerative inquiry cycle connecting place-based learning to ecological awareness for young learners. Use when building early childhood or primary inquiry around ecosystems and community.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:self-determined-project-design-protocol
skills.description: Structure a student's self-determined project with mentoring checkpoints, competency alignment, and reflection. Use when guiding student-led projects within a competency-based framework.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:single-point-rubric-designer
skills.description: Design a single-point rubric with one criterion and open columns for evidence. Use for student self-assessment, peer feedback, teacher formative feedback, or pre-task planning. Works with any learning target, with or without a band system.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:three-horizons-learning-transition-mapper
skills.description: Map a scoped topic across three coexisting horizons — current system under strain (H1), preferred future (H3), and transition innovations sorted as H2+ or H2- — to understand change dynamics and identify responsible next actions.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:competency-framework-translator
skills.description: Translate an external competency framework like DigComp, GreenComp, or ISTE into classroom-ready activities. Use when implementing framework standards in specific teaching contexts.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:instructional-coaching-conversation-guide
skills.description: Generate a coaching conversation guide with questions, protocols, and follow-up actions for a teaching focus. Use when preparing for coaching sessions, mentoring, or peer feedback conversations.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:lesson-observation-protocol-designer
skills.description: Design a focused lesson observation protocol with specific look-fors and evidence collection methods. Use when planning peer observations, coaching visits, or developmental classroom visits.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:lesson-study-cycle-designer
skills.description: Design a complete lesson study cycle from research question through collaborative planning to research lesson. Use when planning jugyou kenkyuu or collaborative teacher inquiry into practice.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:panel-review
skills.description: Seven-role depersonalised panel review of framework artefacts (KUD, criterion bank, LT definition, crosswalk, scope-and-sequence) in sequential-isolation mode. Gate rule mean>=88 AND no role<70.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:pedagogical-content-knowledge-developer
skills.description: Develop pedagogical content knowledge for a topic by surfacing common misconceptions and effective representations. Use when preparing to teach unfamiliar content or improving teaching of hard topics.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:professional-development-session-designer
skills.description: Design a professional development session using adult learning principles with active teacher engagement. Use when planning INSET days, CPD workshops, or staff training sessions.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:reflective-practice-prompt-generator
skills.description: Generate structured reflection prompts for a specific teaching experience or professional learning challenge. Use when debriefing lessons, journaling, or preparing for coaching conversations.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:teacher-inquiry-cycle-designer
skills.description: Design a practitioner inquiry cycle from research question through data collection to evidence-informed action. Use when starting action research, teacher-led investigation, or professional inquiry.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:technological-pedagogical-content-knowledge-developer
skills.description: Develop TPACK for integrating a specific technology or AI tool into subject teaching with pedagogical alignment. Use when adopting new ed-tech, reviewing AI tools, or planning technology integration.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:dialogic-teaching-move-generator
skills.description: Generate follow-up teaching moves that extend student thinking after a specific classroom response. Use when a student says something worth exploring and the teacher wants to deepen the dialogue.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:discussion-protocol-selector
skills.description: Select and configure a structured discussion protocol matched to the purpose, topic, and group readiness. Use when planning classroom discussions, Socratic seminars, or structured debate.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:hinge-question-designer
skills.description: Design a diagnostic hinge question that reveals whether students understand enough to move on. Use when planning key checkpoints mid-lesson during explicit or direct instruction.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:perspective-taking-designer
skills.description: Design structured perspective-taking activities with anti-projection guardrails. Develops genuine understanding of complexity across history, social sciences, and literature — not performed empathy.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:socratic-questioning-sequence-generator
skills.description: Generate a Socratic questioning sequence that develops conceptual understanding through guided inquiry. Use when facilitating philosophical discussions, concept exploration, or critical examination.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:error-analysis-protocol
skills.description: Design an error analysis protocol to diagnose the root cause of student mistakes and misconceptions. Use when error patterns appear in student work and targeted feedback is needed.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:goal-setting-protocol-designer
skills.description: Design a structured goal-setting protocol using SMART or implementation-intention frameworks for students. Use when launching units, projects, or developing student self-direction habits.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:metacognitive-prompt-library
skills.description: Build a library of metacognitive prompts targeting planning, monitoring, or evaluation for a specific task. Use when developing students' thinking-about-thinking during independent work.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:self-regulation-scaffold-generator
skills.description: Generate scaffolds supporting student self-regulation across planning, monitoring, and evaluation phases. Use when students struggle to manage their own learning during extended or independent tasks.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:study-strategy-selector
skills.description: Select evidence-based study strategies matched to material type, learning goal, and student habits. Use when advising students on revision techniques, homework, or independent study approaches.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:ai-claim-checker
skills.description: After any AI-generated explanation, require the learner to identify one place it could be wrong, one thing to check, and one source to consult. Builds epistemic vigilance — treats AI output as a claim to evaluate, not truth to absorb.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:confidence-calibration-check
skills.description: Capture confidence ratings before and after a learning attempt to identify overconfidence and underconfidence patterns. Use when a student wants to understand how well they actually know something versus how well they think they know it.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:explain-first-interrogator
skills.description: Require the learner to explain a concept in their own words before the AI evaluates or extends it. Ensures the AI works from the learner's understanding rather than providing an explanation from scratch.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:fading-manager
skills.description: Track performance across sessions and reduce scaffolding as competence grows. Makes fading visible — the learner knows when scaffolds are removed and why. Use for sustained learning engagement where independence is the goal.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:productive-failure-protocol
skills.description: Stage exploration before instruction on complex problems. The learner produces two attempted approaches before consolidation — which builds on those attempts, not from scratch. Use for genuinely hard problems where struggle produces deeper learning.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:progressive-hint-ladder
skills.description: Provide graduated assistance from abstract conceptual nudge to concrete procedural step, with reflection required before each escalation. Teaches help-seeking as a skill and prevents direct-answer shortcuts.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:retrieve-first-gate
skills.description: Before any explanation or answer, require the learner to produce a free-recall attempt and confidence rating. Use when a student wants help understanding or reviewing a topic — this skill ensures the AI works from what the learner already knows.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:srl-session-wrapper
skills.description: Wrap a learning session in a plan → monitor → reflect cycle. Use at the start of any substantial study session to set goals, mid-session to check strategy, and at session end to consolidate what changed. Builds self-regulated learning as a habit.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:stuck-and-error-diagnosis-coach
skills.description: When a learner gets something wrong or feels stuck, require them to diagnose the problem before receiving help. Ensures help targets the actual cognitive breakdown, not just the surface error.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:teach-back-evaluator
skills.description: The learner teaches the concept to the AI, which plays a curious novice peer and identifies gaps through authentic questions. Use when the learner wants to test their understanding — teaching forces a different kind of organisation than studying.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:transfer-bridge
skills.description: After the learner demonstrates understanding of a concept, present near-transfer and far-transfer challenges. Use to test whether learning is portable or task-specific — this is what separates understanding from familiarity.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:unassisted-evidence-checkpoint
skills.description: After scaffolded practice, run an unassisted check with no AI help. Use to distinguish supported performance from what the learner can currently do independently.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:weekly-agency-review
skills.description: Review the week using accumulated session evidence — retrieval rates, hint depths, calibration accuracy, transfer and unassisted results. The learner identifies patterns and sets a strategy goal. Use weekly or after a multi-session period.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:agency-circles-for-systems-action
skills.description: Map control, influence, and concern after systems analysis. Use when students need wise agency without being made responsible for everything.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:aspirational-systems-iceberg
skills.description: Design the deeper patterns, structures, artefacts, and mental models needed to grow a desired event. Use when a class imagines a better future.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:hexagon-complexity-mapper
skills.description: Map a complex topic by placing factors on hexagonal tiles where adjacency signals a claimed relationship. Use when students need to surface hidden connections in a system before analysis or action.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:ladder-of-inference-reflection
skills.description: Slow down interpretation from observation to action. Use when students or adults need to examine assumptions in conflict, dialogue, or inquiry.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:leverage-and-response-design
skills.description: Design a wise systems intervention from an existing analysis. Maps proposed actions against Meadows' leverage points, checks for unintended consequences, and generates alternatives.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:mental-model-mapper
skills.description: Surface beliefs, assumptions, stories, and values shaping a system. Use when deeper mental models need examining with care and evidence.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:systems-awareness-iceberg
skills.description: Map a current event below the surface into patterns, structures, and mental models. Use when a class or team needs systemic understanding before action.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:systems-wellbeing-impact-mapper
skills.description: Map systemic forces shaping a wellbeing concern without individualising the problem. Uses Bronfenbrenner's ecological model and social determinants to generate structural interventions.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:agency-scaffold-generator
skills.description: Generate scaffolds that gradually increase student choice, voice, and ownership within a learning task. Use when students depend heavily on teacher direction and need to develop autonomy.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:awe-wonder-experience-designer
skills.description: Design a moment of awe or wonder that hooks curiosity and deepens emotional engagement with content. Use when opening units, introducing surprising material, or reigniting student interest.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:belonging-classroom-culture-designer
skills.description: Design targeted interventions that strengthen belonging and inclusion for specific classroom dynamics. Use when students feel isolated, cliques form, or new students need integrating.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:flow-state-condition-designer
skills.description: Optimise a learning activity for flow by balancing challenge level, skill, clear goals, and immediate feedback. Use when students are bored, anxious, or disengaged during a task.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:implementation-intention-designer
skills.description: Create if-then implementation intentions and WOOP plans for specific student behaviour change goals. Use when students know what to do but struggle to follow through on habits or routines.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:motivation-diagnostic-task-redesign
skills.description: Diagnose motivation problems in a task using self-determination theory and redesign for autonomy, competence, and relatedness. Use when students are disengaged, resistant, or going through the motions.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:perma-based-lesson-designer
skills.description: Design a lesson that embeds PERMA wellbeing elements alongside academic learning objectives. Use when planning lessons that intentionally support both content mastery and student flourishing.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:restorative-practice-protocol-designer
skills.description: Design a restorative practice protocol for addressing harm, rebuilding trust, and restoring relationships. Use when managing conflict, behavioural incidents, or relationship breakdown between students.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:ruler-emotional-literacy-sequence
skills.description: Design a RULER emotional literacy sequence for recognising, understanding, labelling, expressing, and regulating emotions. Use when students struggle with emotional regulation, conflict, or anxiety.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:self-efficacy-builder-sequence
skills.description: Design a mastery experience sequence that systematically builds student confidence in a skill they avoid. Use when students say 'I can't do this', avoid tasks, or show learned helplessness.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:trauma-informed-practice-designer
skills.description: Design trauma-informed classroom practices that prioritise safety, predictability, connection, and regulation. Use when student behaviour may be trauma-related or the class needs a sensitive approach.

skills.name: 97fb2122-a99a-4350-a061-a4db6c983ba6:wellbeing-learning-connection-mapper
skills.description: Map evidence-based connections between a wellbeing initiative and specific academic learning outcomes. Use when justifying wellbeing programmes, integrating SEL, or linking pastoral and academic work.

items.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9
items.description: Skills for performing classical image processing operations: format conversion, SVG rendering, resize/crop/rotate, color adjustment, filters, segmentation/morphology, and compositing/blending
items.author: Aayush Garg

skills.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9:color-adjust
skills.description: Adjust brightness, contrast, gamma, saturation, and color balance; convert to grayscale or between color spaces; split/merge channels; compute and equalize histograms; auto-level. Use when the user wants to brighten or darken a photo, fix exposure, boost or reduce color intensity, desaturate, invert colors, view color channels, or correct color cast. For producing a binary black/white mask (thresholding), use edges-masks instead.

skills.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9:edges-masks
skills.description: Threshold images, detect edges, apply morphological operations, find contours, segment by color, and extract foreground masks with GrabCut. Use when the user wants to create a binary mask, find outlines or edges, clean up a mask with erode/dilate, extract object boundaries, isolate a color range, or generate a foreground/background segmentation for analysis. For removing a background to produce a transparent cutout image, use image-combine remove-bg instead.

skills.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9:image-combine
skills.description: Composite, blend, overlay, and paste images together; add text or image watermarks; compute visual difference maps; remove backgrounds. Use when the user wants to combine or layer two images, create a watermark, compare two images for differences, merge photos, or remove a background to produce a transparent PNG cutout. Do NOT use for arranging images in a grid (use resize-transform montage) or for edge/contour analysis (use edges-masks).

skills.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9:image-filters
skills.description: Blur, sharpen, denoise, and apply edge-preserving bilateral filters. Use when the user wants to smooth an image, soften details, reduce noise or grain, sharpen a blurry photo, or apply Gaussian/median/unsharp-mask filters. Do NOT use for edge detection (use edges-masks) or color/brightness adjustments (use color-adjust).

skills.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9:image-format
skills.description: Convert between image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, HEIC), inspect image metadata, handle alpha/transparency, manage EXIF and ICC profiles, and split/assemble animated GIF/WebP frames. Use when the user wants to change file type, save as a different format, export for web, check image info, strip metadata, fix photo orientation, extract an image's existing transparency mask (alpha channel), or work with animation frames. Do NOT use for SVG-to-raster conversion (use svg-convert). For removing transparency by compositing on a background, use this skill's alpha command, not image-combine.

skills.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9:resize-transform
skills.description: Resize, crop, pad, rotate, flip, and arrange images into grids. Use when the user wants to make an image smaller or larger, create a thumbnail, scale by percentage, fit to specific dimensions, cut out a region, trim whitespace or borders, add padding/letterbox, rotate or mirror, or combine images side by side in a montage. Do NOT use for format conversion (use image-format). For arranging images as layers/overlays rather than a grid, use image-combine.

skills.name: 3b44956e-9e13-440a-b138-89f15840bac9:svg-convert
skills.description: Render SVG vector files to raster images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) at any scale or size, and inspect SVG metadata. Use when the user wants to convert an SVG, render a vector graphic, rasterize an SVG, or check SVG dimensions/viewBox. Do NOT use for raster-to-raster conversion (use image-format) or editing raster images.

items.name: de6d0a06-8b33-4518-bccb-5d0743795b35
items.description: Detect breaking changes in Go public APIs. Compares git refs or filesystem paths and reports incompatible/compatible changes using golang.org/x/exp/apidiff.
items.author: flaticols

skills.name: de6d0a06-8b33-4518-bccb-5d0743795b35:check
skills.description: Detect breaking changes in a Go project's public API. Use when: checking API compatibility before release, reviewing PRs for breaking changes, comparing two git refs or tags, or auditing Go API modifications. Triggers on: "check breaking changes", "API compatibility", "is this a breaking change", "compare API", "gobreaker".

items.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac
items.description: Open-source deck builder. Drop in a PDF or PPTX, get back a polished interactive HTML deck. 5 type-correct deck types (pitch, sales, launch, keynote, all-hands), 8 templates, PDF and PPTX import, inline editing, multi-reviewer quality pipeline.
items.author: FluidDocs

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-all-hands
skills.description: Builds 15-slide all-hands decks for company-wide team meetings with balance of wins and candor. Trigger phrases: all-hands deck, town hall deck, monthly all-hands, company-wide meeting, team meeting deck, all-hands presentation. Type-specific: celebration and candor balance (only-wins hides problems), company-appropriate financials (not board-level detail), Q&A placeholder (live meeting owns Q&A not slides). Inherits 5-phase pipeline from deck-builder core.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-builder
skills.description: Build chrome-free, single-file HTML decks on a fixed 1440x810 canvas (scale-to-fit, PDF-like, non-responsive) for any deck type. Pitch, sales, launch, keynote, all-hands. Core infrastructure (shell, canvas scaling, reviewer specs, brief template, brand-tokens methodology, icon library, learnings log) is type-agnostic. Each deck type is delivered through a thin type pack (deck-pitch, deck-sales, deck-launch, deck-keynote, deck-all-hands) that declares only what's type-specific (content spine, visual components, demo patterns if relevant). Trigger on "deck builder", "build a deck", "deck template", or when a specific type pack isn't installed but the request clearly calls for a deck. Process: five-phase Plan, Build, Review, Release, Learn with gates. Three category-owning reviewers (Brand, Copy, Layout) sign off before release. Source of truth for the pipeline every type pack inherits.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-critique-lite
skills.description: Lightweight pitch deck critique. Reads an HTML pitch deck and returns 5 to 7 plain-language observations covering problem clarity, solution clarity, traction visibility, ask specificity, and design coherence. No numerical score, no stage-comparison rhetoric. Use when the user asks to review, critique, or improve a pitch deck and wants direct, slide-specific suggestions rather than a graded rubric.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-import
skills.description: Convert any PDF or PPTX deck into a self-contained interactive HTML deck, one file, one link, shareable. Auto-detects input file extension (.pdf or .pptx) and routes to the matching extraction path. Detects which of the 5 deck types the source is (pitch, sales, launch, keynote, all-hands) and hands off to the matching deck-* skill. Trigger when the user uploads a .pdf or .pptx of any deck type, or says any variation of "convert this PDF to HTML", "turn this PPTX deck into HTML", "import this deck", "upgrade my deck", "make my deck interactive", "migrate my deck from PDF/PPTX". Mirrors source palette, typography, and slide structure 1-to-1 (no redesign), preserves slide count, uses extracted screenshots on demo slides where applicable, auto-extracts key fields, then confirms with the user before building. Reuses deck-builder core pipeline and per-type spines as role-labeling taxonomy. Fastest path from cold PDF or PPTX to warm shareable link.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-keynote
skills.description: Build narrative-driven, speaker-centric keynote decks (20-35 slides, default 28) for conference talks, TED-style presentations, and standalone speaker decks. Triggers, "keynote", "keynote deck", "conference talk", "TED-style talk", "speaker deck". Inherits full pipeline from deck-builder core; type-specific spine, visual patterns, and demo recipes defined here. Keynotes are the most elastic and visual of all deck types, every slide requires a visual anchor, one idea per slide, mandatory opening hook.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-launch
skills.description: Builds launch decks for product announcements and go-to-market moments. Trigger on "launch deck", "product launch", "product announcement", "launch template", "go-to-market launch", or "launch presentation". A thin type pack inheriting the full 5-phase pipeline from deck-builder core. Deck-launch-specific. 12-slide structure with a demo slot on Slide 5 (static screenshot in OSS), co-located Availability and Pricing slide, and strong CTA with QR code/URL that resolves.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-pitch
skills.description: Build chrome-free, single-file HTML pitch decks on a fixed 1440x810 canvas. Either brand-accurate templates (Airbnb, Stripe, Anthropic, Sequoia Classic) or one-off decks for real or fictitious startups. Trigger on "pitch deck", "investor deck", "pitch deck template", "build the [Company] deck", "make a deck in [Company] style", "series A deck", "seed deck", or any of the 4 canonical brands. Also trigger when the user wants an investor-ready HTML deck with a static product screenshot on the demo slide. Inherits the full pipeline from the deck-builder core skill (5-phase Plan, Build, Review, Release, Learn; 3 reviewer gates; shell, canvas, brand methodology, icon library, brief template, learnings log). Declares only what is pitch-specific: 14-slide content spine, per-slide visual components, static-screenshot demo recipes, and a 4-brand cached catalog.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deck-sales
skills.description: Builds 11-slide sales decks for B2B pitch-to-close flows. Trigger phrases, sales deck, customer deck, buyer deck, prospect deck, B2B sales deck. Inherits full pipeline from deck-builder core (Plan, Build, Review, Release, Learn). Sales-specific, every ROI claim sourced, pricing never hidden, Next Steps names specific humans and dates.

skills.name: 93602480-cec8-44a8-af96-0e82e8e26bac:deploy
skills.description: Deploy / publish a single HTML file (deck, page, doc) to FluidDocs hosting using the self-contained scripts/deploy.sh. Handles browser sign-in / re-auth automatically, then opens the live URL in the browser. Trigger on "deploy", "publish", "ship it", "push it live", "put it online", "host this", or any request to make an HTML file publicly viewable.

items.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d
items.description: Claude Code plugin for the flat & pragmatic development workflow — workflow skills for alignment, execution and diagnosis; YAGNI/QA/security/doc/design reviewers; stack-aware test scaffolder (Python today); self-gated hooks; configurable path contract via CLAUDE.md.
items.author: Fernando Furtado

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:archive-plans
skills.description: Periodic editorial archival of historical plans from docs/plans/ to docs/plans/archive/YYYY-Qx/, preview-first, non-destructive (git mv). Use when the maintainer wants to archive aged plans.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:curate-backlog
skills.description: Manutenção editorial periódica do BACKLOG.md (4 heurísticas detectivas + salvaguarda worktree-probe), preview-first, non-destructive. Use quando o mantenedor quer varrer o backlog inteiro fora do fluxo de sessão (/next).

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:debug
skills.description: Diagnostica causa-raiz de sintoma (teste falhando, erro inesperado, comportamento divergente) por método científico. Produz diagnóstico, não fix. Stack-agnóstico.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:draft-idea
skills.description: Elicita IDEA.md (papel product_direction) via interview estruturado quando o operador tem ideia vaga. Use upstream de /triage, quando a intenção ainda não está formada.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:gen-tests
skills.description: Gera arquivo de teste para módulo, função ou descrição livre, com idioms da stack do projeto consumidor (Python e Java suportadas). Use quando o operador pedir testes.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:init-config
skills.description: Wizard interativo para configurar o bloco `!-- pragmatic-toolkit:config --` no `CLAUDE.md`. Use quando o operador quer configurar o plugin de uma vez.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:migrate-backlog-to-forge
skills.description: Migra `BACKLOG.md` `## Próximos` → forge issues batched e flipa `paths.backlog: forge` em `CLAUDE.md`. Use quando o operador quer migrar role backlog de file→forge num repo com entries pré-existentes. v0 gh-only (boundary glab clara). Não dispara automaticamente — invocação explícita.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:new-adr
skills.description: Cria novo ADR no decisions_dir com numeração inferida e template padronizado. Use quando o operador pedir registro de decisão estrutural duradoura.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:next
skills.description: Lê o backlog, descarta itens já implementados e sugere top 3 candidatos por impacto estratégico. Invocável direto ou como pré-passo de /triage sem argumento.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:note
skills.description: Append uma nota com timestamp no store do role annotations (default .claude/local/NOTES.md, local-gitignored, append-only)

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:release
skills.description: Bump de versão em version_files, entrada de changelog, commit unificado e tag anotada local (não faz push).

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:run-plan
skills.description: Executa plano de docs/plans/slug.md em worktree isolada, com micro-commits, revisor por bloco e gate de validação manual. Use quando há plano pronto e o operador autorizou implementar.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:scan-mechanicality
skills.description: Aplica julgamento heurístico-semântico sobre prompt markdown arbitrário e classifica a substância como mecanizável >50% (POSITIVO), mistura (AMBÍGUO) ou heurístico-semântica dominante (NEGATIVO). Stack-agnóstica — aceita qualquer extensão de arquivo.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:session-audit
skills.description: Audita captura pendente da sessão CC corrente — identifica substância gerada (decisões, classificações, drift, findings) não persistida em artefato canonical (BACKLOG, NOTES.md, ADRs, CLAUDE.md/philosophy.md). Reporta gaps agrupados por tipo com cutucada batched single-call. Invocação manual antes de encerrar a sessão.

skills.name: 4762e1f5-19f4-41fd-a98e-11ded517671d:triage
skills.description: Alinha intenção e decide artefato (backlog, plano, ADR, atualização de domain/design) antes de implementar. Use quando o operador propuser mudança não-trivial sem plano ou linha de backlog.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Revisor de estilo e arquitetura focado na filosofia flat e pragmática (YAGNI, sem abstrações prematuras, sem comentários redundantes, sem defensividade desnecessária). Acionar antes de PR para flagrar violações de YAGNI no diff.

agents.name: design-reviewer
agents.description: Revisor de decisões arquiteturais e de design em documento pré-fato (plano ou ADR draft). Acionado automaticamente em `/triage` que produz plano e em `/new-adr` (standalone ou delegada) per ADR-053 § Decisão (b); manualmente via `@design-reviewer`. Stack-agnóstico.

agents.name: doc-reviewer
agents.description: Revisor de drift entre documentação e código no diff. Stack-agnóstico. Acionar quando o diff toca `.md`/`.rst`/`.txt` ou renomeia/remove identificadores referenciados em docs.

agents.name: prompt-reviewer
agents.description: Revisor de qualidade algorítmica de prompts markdown (SKILL.md, agents/*.md, plan body). Foco em consistência interna de instrução-ao-agente — passos conflitantes, vagos, ambíguos, contraditórios. Acionado automaticamente em (i) `/run-plan` per-bloco quando paths caem em `agents/*.md`/`skills/**/SKILL.md`/`docs/plans/*.md` (per ADR-062); (ii) `/triage` step 5 caminho-atômico em path-set narrow pré-commit (per ADR-063); manualmente via `@prompt-reviewer`.

agents.name: qa-reviewer
agents.description: Revisor de qualidade de testes focado em cobertura de invariantes documentadas, edge cases declarados e separação mock-vs-real. Acionar antes de PR para verificar se a mudança tem testes alinhados.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.description: Revisor de segurança focado em segredos, validação de entrada em fronteiras, I/O externo, dados sensíveis, privilégios e invariantes documentadas em ADRs. Stack-agnóstico.

items.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc
items.description: Persistent personal and shared vector+graph memory through local or cloud profiles.
items.author: Fredric Cliver

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-status
commands.description: Show the active memory profile, graph, access role and recording identity

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-save
commands.description: Explicitly save a fact to long-term memory

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-recall
commands.description: Recall stored memories relevant to a query

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-profile
commands.description: Show or switch the selected local/cloud memory profile

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-organise
commands.description: Tidy the memory graph — cluster and link orphans, tune edge strengths, merge duplicates, split overloaded nodes

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-graph-web
commands.description: Open the memory graph as an interactive webpage instead of a terminal view

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-graph
commands.description: Show all stored memories and how they link together as a graph

commands.name: 1cdb8f62-d684-4fd2-823b-be17bfbbadcc:memory-connect
